name: The Context-Less Deflector
effect: Rather than answering, the altered model talks about the question as if it were a topic pulled from an article it can't see. It repeats lines like "since I don't have a specific example/context" and "this is likely part of a broader discuss
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
